 Lululemon’s Black Friday Deals Are Live—Here’s What an Athleisure-Obsessed Editor Would Shop 
 Including tried-and-true Align leggings for under $50.
 By Lauren Gruber Published: Nov 19, 2026 8:00 AM EST Save Article Share Article We may earn commission from links on this page, but we only recommend products we love. Promise. 
 As a lululemon stan since my tween years (I’ve been rocking my Aligns for over a decade), I know that the brand’s workout gear and loungewear are worth the money—but that doesn’t necessarily mean I want to pay full price. Thankfully, lululemon’s Black Friday Early Access sale just landed , bringing savings on the brand’s most popular products.
 Head Straight to lululemon’s Black Friday Early Access Sale 
 If you're as lululemon-obsessed as I am, you know that the brand pretty much never hosts sales (aside from Black Friday and New Year’s)—meaning now is the time to finally invest in the viral Define jacket or stock up on Align leggings (a Cosmo editor favorite ) while they're as low as $49. I also found a handful of gift-worthy stocking stuffers for the lululemon fanatic on your list, like plush fuzzy socks and an adorable belt bag keychain .
 Best lululemon Black Friday Finds Under $30

 Now 50% Off $18 $9 at Lululemon lululemon Clippable Card Pouch
 Now 44% Off $34 $19 at Lululemon You don't need to spend a fortune to score some Lulu presents, and these finds are proof. The Everywhere Belt Bag is one of our editors’ all-time favorite gifts, and you can score it for just $19. If your sock drawer could use a refresh, I found them on sale in so many colors and styles, like this hot pink fuzzy pair . And I even spotted some apparel for under $30, like this classic tank top .

My personal favorite is the Like a Cloud bra , which is made from a ridiculously lightweight, breathable fabric that keeps boob sweat at bay. What’s more, I spotted the viral (and editor-adored) Align leggings for just $49 in select colors.

 $79 at Lululemon Leggings are always a coveted find during lululemon’s sales, and this year didn’t disappoint. Need help deciding between styles? Aligns are ideal for yoga and low-impact workouts with their stretchy, whisper-soft fabric, while the Wunder Trains are durable enough for high-impact activities. Plus, the cult-favorite ABC pants are on sale in select colors right now, and they make a great gift for the man in your life (wink, wink).

And don’t sleep on lululemon’s sneaker lineup—the Wildfeel has a durable, grippy outsole that’s ideal for trail running.
